sloka: तयोः कृतव्रणौ देहौ शुशुभाते महात्मनोः।सपुष्पाविव निष्पत्रौ वने शाल्मलिकिंशुकौ ।। ६.८९.३६ ।।
transliteration: tayoḥ kṛtavraṇau dehau śuśubhāte mahātmanoḥ।sapuṣpāviva niṣpatrau vane śālmalikiṁśukau ।। 6.89.36 ।।

translations.english: In the battle the terrific arrows appeared to the eyes like kusa grass spread by the sacred fire.
